{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the six internal QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")
print("First few QA order IDs:")
print(qa_orders['order_id'].head())

# Check if there are any other invalid revenue values
invalid_revenue = data[~data['revenue'].str.match(r'^\d+\.\d{2}$', na=False) & ~data['revenue'].str.match(r'^\d+,\d+\.\d{2}$', na=False)]
print(f"Number of invalid revenue entries: {len(invalid_revenue)}")
print("Invalid revenue values:")
print(invalid_revenue['revenue'].unique())"}
